How we know

The club's ride-start page gives the weekend start by month (9:00 am December to April, 8:30 am May and October, 8:00 am June to September, nothing for November) and its calendar lists Crankin' Saturday from Smith St at 8:30 am on Sat Oct 3, 2026 (read Oct 1, 2026).

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:30 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
C, C+, B and B+ groups. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @huntington_bicycle_club the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Huntington Bicycle Club Weekend Rides group ride

Huntington Bicycle Club Weekend Rides is a road group ride in Greenlawn, NY. It rolls saturdays and Sundays at 8:30 am from Smith Street Lot.

Several pace groups leave the Smith Street lot every weekend, all year. Weekday groups meet at Bethany Church and Breezy Park in Huntington Station. Ride sign-up on the club calendar is required.
